steps.content: On stage, the lighting subtly shifts from a stark, cold white to a cozy, warm yellow, breathing life into the streets that were quiet just moments ago.
The streets come alive with constant motion again. The bakery chef, in a familiar rhythm, emerges yet again from the adjoining kitchen, carrying a large tray of bread, golden and freshly baked.
But this time, something is different. Instead of the girl who had fled her cage, the buildings alongside the road reveal a new face—a redhead girl with charmingly tied twin ponytails.

steps.speaker: Chef
steps.content: Hey Ignis, the bread's freshly baked. Care for a few?

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Absolutely!
Ignis lingers at the roadside briefly. Seizing a quick break in the traffic, she scurries across in dainty steps to the opposite side of the road.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Chef, why does your bread taste so much better than mine? What's the secret?

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: We're using the exact same ingredients and techniques!

steps.speaker: Chef
steps.content: Hehe, if making bread like mine was that easy, everyone would be opening their own bakeries!

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Psh. Just wait till I get the hang of it, I'll bake something even tastier than yours.
The chef chuckles warmly, bagging three buttery rolls for Ignis.
The delightful scent is so tempting. It could make anyone unwrap and devour one right there on the sidewalk.

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Hmm?
An odd voice resonates in Ignis's thoughts while she gazes at the alley's door numbers. She faintly remembers she was supposed to do something here, but it just wouldn't come back to her.
This is the life you want to choose for yourself, right?

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: Yeah, living a normal life, being a normal girl...

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: No one to criticize me, no one on my heels... I can joyfully cook up tasty meals...

steps.speaker: The Choice of Destiny
steps.content: Of course... you can live this life forever...

steps.speaker: Ignis
steps.content: I've always dreamed... of living like this forever, cooking up mouth-watering dishes... My desire... is to share them with my family, my friends, and... with Chief...

steps.speaker: The Choice of Destiny
steps.content: Yes... Yes... I hear your choice.
